items.title: Why fewer than 1% people in Bangladesh invest in stocks
items.description: Stock market participation remains low in Bangladesh, with around 17 lakh beneficiary owner (BO) accounts against a population of nearly 18 crore, representing less than 1 percent.

items.title: Govt aims to pull capital market out of crisis: Khosru
items.description: Finance and Planning Minister Amir Khosru Mahmud Chowdhury said stock exchanges and market intermediaries had failed over the past decade, contributing to the capital market falling into the same ditch as the economy.

items.title: Dutch-Bangla Bank holds strategic conclave for Barishal region
items.description: Dutch-Bangla Bank PLC (DBBL) on Friday held its “Strategic Conclave 2026” for the Barishal region at a local hotel in Barishal to formulate business strategies for its branches and strengthen customer service.

items.title: Pubali Bank offers banking benefits to United Healthcare staff, clients
items.description: Pubali Bank PLC has signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with United Healthcare Services Ltd, a Dhaka-based private healthcare and medical services organisation, to strengthen collaboration between the two organisations.

items.title: Shaheen made AMD of Mercantile Bank
items.description: Mercantile Bank PLC has appointed Ahmed Shaheen as its additional managing director (AMD).
